caregivers.title: Unlimited caregivers
caregivers.sub: Everyone who helps, in one circle. Only you pay.

voice.title: Add by voice
voice.sub: Say a medication, appointment or task and the form fills in. On supported phones.

exports.title: Adherence reports and calendar import
exports.sub: Export doses taken, skipped and not marked. Import appointments from your phone's calendar.

storage.title: 1 GB of documents per circle
storage.sub: Room for records, photos and paperwork. The free plan has 200 MB.

ai.title: Care assistant
ai.sub: Answers questions about the schedule, medications and doses. It can't change anything and doesn't give medical advice.

shifts.title: Care shifts
shifts.sub: Plan who covers when. Everyone sees who's on.

team.title: Managers and weekly care summary
team.sub: A member can help you invite and manage people. Each member gets a weekly email.

circles.title: Up to 5 care circles
circles.sub: One for each person you care for.

plans.termsAnnual: {{price}} per year. Renews every year until you cancel in your account settings.
plans.termsMonthly: {{price}} per month. Renews every month until you cancel in your account settings.
plans.termsAnnualTrial: {{length}} free, then {{price}} per year. Renews every year until you cancel in your account settings.
plans.termsMonthlyTrial: {{length}} free, then {{price}} per month. Renews every month until you cancel in your account settings.

orUseApp: Prefer the app? You can also upgrade in the CircleCare app and pay through your app store.

storeOnly.bodyDesktop: CircleCare Premium is available in the CircleCare app on your phone. Install it, sign in with this same email, and start your subscription from Settings.

alreadyPremium.title: You're already Premium
alreadyPremium.body: You have full access to all CircleCare features.
alreadyPremium.manageInApp: Manage your subscription in the CircleCare app where you purchased it.

success.title: Welcome to Premium!
success.body: Your subscription is active. Enjoy full access across your care circles.

onboarding.continueFreeSub: 1 care circle, you + 1 caregiver. Reminders and alerts are always free.

headlineOnboarding: Share the care with everyone who helps.

headlineOnboardingInvite: Bring in everyone who helps, not just one.
